title: Research: independently audit PR #4091's pooled duals with rational binomial bounds
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds `research/staged-fourth-dual-binomial-audit/` only: an independent exact audit of the pooled-dual proof in Ross Richardson's PR #4091, with a written proof, source pins, a deterministic certificate and 21 arithmetic/control tests. **No discrepancy was found. No new κ.**

- All 841 whole-helper bin patterns (5 / 21 / 158 / 657 at capacities 8 / 16 / 32 / 48), enumerated by a Cartesian product and cross-checked against a generating-function recurrence.
- All three duals (left / middle / right), re-solved from exact equality systems rather than executed from the published formulas, and checked on every pattern for every real `0.00173 <= a <= 0.00174`: 11 / 8 / 9 identically tight patterns, every other reduced cost strictly positive.
- The central balance system (determinant −10) forces the unique global optimum `x = 1080`; affine primal witnesses cover every real mixture `0 <= x <= 3240`.

The numerical method is new: a positive binomial series for `(r^(1-a) - r)/a` with integer outward rounding and an explicit geometric tail. It imports no predecessor Python, no logarithm/exponential engine and no optimizer. Dual coefficients and primal multiplicities are solved from exact equality systems. The theorem and its witnesses remain Ross Richardson's contribution; there is no new κ, root-digit refinement, construction or supplier admission.

The complete bill keeps `3240 L3 + x(L4-L3)` and every residual, including empty bins, against `(896*360)H73`. The local paid-profile reports and the stock coefficient are inherited premises. This audit does not establish local-transition or native correctness, chronology, family exclusion, offsets, physical stock, compiler, all-size, precision/tape, BIT or outer admission. The selected record on main (#5413, κ = 0.003027288235) is a changed mechanism far above this fixed-model cap (about 0.0017310), so the cap does not constrain it.

A checked consequence answers PR #5280's pooled-feasibility question. At `x = 1090`, the right-face witness uses five capacity-48 bins `(6,6,9,9,9,9)` and leaves idle `{3:22783, 5:1625, 48:138492}`. The central eight-pattern support forces `x = 1080`, and its idle multiset has ten too few residual rank units for 1090 (the total residual rank grows by exactly one per fourth-entry call). So PR #4170's question about reaching that same multiset at 1090 needs a changed mixture or invoice. These consequences already follow from PR #4091's formulas; no discovery priority is claimed.

Stop at a discrepancy or a completed certificate; no expansion or packing search.

Nearest overlap: PR #4091 supplies the original theorem and its own primary and secondary checks. PR #4170 and PR #5280 check source transfer and explicitly exclude the dual proof. Overlap searches used the task plus `staged-fourth-mixture-ceiling`, `pooled dual`, `841 patterns` and `binomial`, alongside the ledger and retained packages. The final offline report covered all 7,404 tracked local notes, 371 open PRs (snapshot 2026-10-25 05:31 UTC) and 4,779 Discussion records (05:33 UTC), with complete pagination as reported. A cached snapshot is not a live novelty guarantee or a search of arbitrary diffs.

## Validation

Python 3.12.3 on Linux, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged-fourth-dual-binomial-audit --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged-fourth-dual-binomial-audit
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/staged-fourth-dual-binomial-audit --check-source-history
```

All pass. The registered replay runs the checker and 21 tests in both normal and optimized modes. Expected checker line:

```text
PASS_STAGED_FOURTH_DUAL_BINOMIAL_AUDIT patterns=841 duals=3 tight=11/8/9 unique_x=1080
```

The 2,523 dual inequalities split into 28 symbolic equalities and 2,495 strictly positive interval inequalities. Conservative lower bounds on nonzero slack divided by `a` are 4.38806, 0.69698 and 2.37161 for left/middle/right. Exact rational linear solves recover all three dual systems, the central determinant −10 and both affine primal segments. The signed bill has opposite signs at the coarse endpoints 0.00173 and 0.00174; the published 24-place root bracket is not freshly verified here.

Controls include exact rational powers and square identities for every rank 1..73; a Fraction partial-sum oracle; omitted-tail discrimination; omitted empty/nonempty patterns and count-preserving duplicates; a zero-rank-mass dual perturbation with genuinely negative slack; inadequate numerical precision; wrong mixture, width or historical replica factor; an omitted local charge; and corrupt source bytes. No floating-point decision supplies acceptance.

Committed-byte/source-history validation covers 16 payloads. The official export and its offline integrity check pass. All four direct commands then pass from that export with read-only files and directories, an empty `PATH`, no Git use, and all 16 payload hashes unchanged. A direct checker run takes about one second; timing is host-dependent.

The written proof plus finite exhaustive arithmetic supports the declared LP claim. It is not a formal-kernel proof or an independent human review. No full source-native, ordinary/outer, selected-frontier, Lean or Docker replay was run.

## Open next questions

See the package README and `TASK.json`. No further search is justified inside this fixed invoice: PR #4181 already reports attaining the cap. A consequential next construction must name a changed word, inventory or consumer boundary, identify the balance or cost equation that changes, and supply the complete signed invoice before borrowing any ceiling. Source-transition and physical-admission obligations remain separate; the inherited local paid profiles have not been reconstructed from every source transition.
